title: Constraint: 5 % Matching Lower Bits
constraints: `a` and `b` are 8-bit. Their lower nibbles are equal in about **5 %** of the results (measured over 2000 calls, accepted 2.5 … 8 %).
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Plain randomization gives 1/16 = 6.25 %. Close, but not what was asked.
Use a helper `rand bit same;` with `same dist {1 := 5, 0 := 95};`, and tie it to the data: `same == (a[3:0] == b[3:0]);`.
The equivalence (`==`) matters: an implication alone would let `same = 0` still produce matches.
